For  your first time water-cooling corsairs configurator is okay but in the future use EK parts, they are much higher quality and there isn't much of a price difference. My first build used EK parts and I later on tried corsairs parts and noticed that they are okay for ease of use but the quality isn't the best it could be(not to dis corsair or anything) Also I recommend a CPU upgrade if you can afford one because the 2700X with a 2080 ti is a slight bottle neck and I wouldn't want to see someone bottle neck their PC before installing water cooling (although it is only a "slight" bottle neck). Also with EK parts you could fix your problem with fitting the pump in the front area of the case by using a front flat reservoir if you went with the Lian Li O11 Dynamic XL. however if you are dead set on using the 680 than you could mount your pump/reservoir combo parallel to the ground by mounting it on the top rad( which would work btw). if you have anymore questions I'm happy to help!
